summary.text: Rich Lascelles is a Republican state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 14 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a U.S. Navy veteran who has been affiliated with Litchfield town bodies.

paragraphs.text: Richard Lascelles was born in Illinois and served in the U.S. Navy, according to Ballotpedia.
He has been affiliated with the Litchfield Recreation Commission, the Litchfield Budget Committee and the Litchfield Board of Selectmen.
Ballotpedia lists Lascelles's House tenure as beginning in 2016, and he has represented Hillsborough 14 since the 2022 election.
He was assigned to the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs Committee in 2017 and 2019-2020 and to the Municipal and County Government Committee for the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
